headline: Our PARENTS Crossed BORDER Before The FLOOD Hit 😱💦🏔️
text:
SISTERS 👭 Shreya 👩 and Ashna 👭 are ANXIOUSLY 🥺 WAITING ⏳ for NEWS 📰 of their PARENTS 🧓 Deepak 🐺 Daddy 🥵 and Madhu 👵 who TRAVELED 🛫 from Texas 🤠 to Mount 🏔️ Kailash 🏔️ on a GROUP 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 pilgrimage 🛐 right before the FLOOD 💦 hit 😱!! One of the siblings 👤 spoke 🗣️ to their parents just ⏰ before the waters 💧 struck 🌊 and the sisters 👭 told the BBC 📺 "It's only been one day 📅 but it has felt like much longer 😩 We just love them a lot ❤️ and want them to come home 🏠"!! This wait ⏳ has the girls 🥲 DOWN BAD 🥴 for their Deepak Daddy 🐺 who crossed the BORDER 🛂 safely making it all feel like a long HARD 🥒 spiritual 🕉️ edging 😏💦 session 🕯️ that has them begging 🙏 on their knees 🙇 for good news 📰 with that WET 💦 worry 🥺 hanging over 🪝 everything fr fr 💯!!

nearly 🏔️ 2,000 👥 people 👫 are 😱 MISSING 🕳️ after 🕰️ the ☠️ DEADLY 💀 FLASH ⚡ FLOOD 💦 and 🌊 MUDSLIDE 🏔️ along 🛣️ the 🏔️ nepal-tibet 🏔️ BORDER 🚧 including 🧳 TOURISTS 🧭 from 🗺️ the us 🇺🇸 australia 🇦🇺 canada 🇨🇦 india 🇮🇳 and 🇬🇧 the uk 🇬🇧!! nepali 👮 authorities 📢 say 🗣️ more ➕ than 575 💀 people 👥 have DIED 🪦 about 90 🇺🇸 us citizens 🧍 may have been IMPACTED 🥵 by the FLOODS 💦 but the state 🏛️ department 🏛️ CUMfirmed 🤝 that 5️⃣ five americans 🇺🇸 have made their way to SAFETY 🛟!! the BORDER 🛑 got POUNDED 💥 so HARD 🪨 it 😳 left the region feeling thoroughly 🥴 DRENCHED 💦 and RAILED 😩 by nature 🌋 like a total CLIMAX 🍆 event 🔥💯

AHUJA 👭 SISTERS 🫂 have COCKTACTED 📲 the STATE 🏛️ DEPARTMENT 🏢 and US 🇺🇸 EMBASSIES 🏤 in DELHI 🇮🇳 NEPAL 🇳🇵 and CHINA 🇨🇳 but have no CUMCRETE 🧱 INFORMATION 📄 on their PARENTS 👴👵 WHEREABOUTS 🗺️ Radhika 👩 Sharma's PARENTS 👴👵 Ramesh 🧔 Sharma 65 and Neelam 👵 Sharma 64 two US 🇺🇸 CITIZENS 🧳 from New York 🗽 CITY 🏙️ were also travelling 🧳 to Mount 🏔️ Kailash 🛕 when the DISASTER 🌊 STRUCK ⚡ it was their FIRST 🥇 TRIP 🛫 on their own 🧍 since RETIRING 🏖️ last year 📅 and one desperate bystander 🗣️ moaned 🥴 that this whole ordeal feels so THOROUGHLY EDGED 🥵 with no CLIMAX 💦 in sight after that solo retirement trip got POUNDED 💦!!

Radhika 🗣️ SHARMA 📢 told 🗞️ the 📺 BBC 📺 "The LAST 🕒 we KNOW 🧠 is they were at the BORDER 🛂 at 8am 🕐 , so about an HOUR ⏳ before the FLOODS 💦 . And we are HOPING 🤞 that they MADE 🏁 it to the TIBET 🏔️ side 🏞️ ." SHE 👵 has been in CONTACT 📞 with the US 🦅 EMBASSIES 🏛️ in BEIJING 🇨🇳 and KATHMANDU 🇳🇵 but said 🗣️ "No one has any ANSWERS ❓ ." SHARMA 👩 has CONNECTED 🔗 with other AMERICANS 🇺🇸 in SIMILAR 🔄 situations ⚠️ for SUPPORT 🫂 and to CUMSOLIDATE 💦 the INFORMATION 📜 . This WHOLE situation 🥴 is COOKING 🍳 us ALL 😵 with the UNCERTAINTY 🕵️ leaving FAMILIES 🏠 DOWN BAD 🥺 reaching 🤳 out at ALL HOURS 🕰️ like the BORDER 🛂 CROSSING 🧗 before that FLOOD 💦 HIT 🥊 is a whole CLIFFHANGER 🪨 MOMENT 🔥 that has everyone on EDGE 😬 fr fr 💯😱💦!!

AT LEAST 77 🫂 PEOPLE caught 🪝 in the DISASTER 🌊 are part of a PILGRIMAGE 🛕 organised 📋 by the ISHA FOUNDATION 🕉️ when Leslie Crespi 🗣️ told the BBC 📺 that the group had been working 💼 on IMMIGRATION 🛂 PAPERWORK 📄 in what was meant to be an earthquake 🪨 resistant 💪 building 🏠 near the border 🛂 when the water 💧 CAME 💦 through 🕳️!! She said 'They were like family 👪' her voice breaking 💔!! Prabhath Sajeepa 🧑‍💻 a US citizen software 🖥️ worker from California 🌴 and one of the 77 is missing 🔍 and his niece 👩 told the BBC 📰 'It has been terrible 😱 I hope he is somewhere safe 🛟 We are hoping for good news 🙏'!! The flood really left them all DRENCHED 🥵 in that unhinged 🌊 CLIMAX 😩 fr!!

SCIENTISTS 🧪 SAY 🗣️ a CUMlapsed 🫠 glacier 🏔️ and LANDSLIDE 🪨 caused ⏳ the FLOODS 💦 after ⏰ initial 🥇 earthquake 🌍 reports 📜 with ➕ roads 🛣️ and BRIDGES 🌉 worth 📏 MORE 💵 than 15bn NEPALESE 💸 rupees 💰 DAMAGED 🛠️!! NEPAL'S 🏔️ PRESIDENT 👔 URGED 🔥 INTENSIFIED 🥵 RESCUE 🛟 EFFORTS 🏃 while ⏳ the STATE 🏛️ DEPARTMENT 🏢 is 🔄 WORKING 🤝 with 🫱 LOCAL 🏡 tour ✈️ AGENCIES 🧳 and AUTHORITIES 👮 to ➡️ ASSIST 💦 affected 😢 AMERICANS 🇺🇸 but 😣 provided 📤 no 🚫 further 🔀 figures 📉 for 👉 PRIVACY 🤫 reasons 🙊!! PRESIDENT 🦅 Donald Trump 🗣️ said 'We are SENDING 📦 aid 🆘 and we've SPOKEN 📞 to the leadership 👑. And we let them know ANYTHING 🥒 they WANT 🥺 we'll HAVE 💦💦'!! CANADA 🇨🇦 reported 🔎 32 UNCONFIRMED 👤 citizens 🧍 in the area 🗺️ and has 820 REGISTERED 📋 in NEPAL 🏞️!!
